data.body_html:
If you want to explore the exclusive Sotogrande marina and coastline but don’t hold a boating license, you’re in luck. With Sotogrande boat rental no license options, you can charter a fully crewed vessel from Puerto Banús and cruise to Sotogrande in under 30 minutes. Every boat in our fleet includes a professional skipper, so no qualification is required—just show up and enjoy the Mediterranean.

Why Choose a No-License Boat Rental in Sotogrande?

Sotogrande is one of Costa del Sol’s most prestigious destinations, home to a luxury marina, world-class golf courses, and fine dining. Renting a boat without a license means you can focus on the experience—sunbathing, swimming, and sightseeing—while a skipper handles navigation. It’s perfect for families, groups of friends, or corporate outings who want a stress-free day on the water.

Our Fleet for Sotogrande Trips

We offer a range of boats suitable for Sotogrande charters, all departing from Puerto Banús. Here are the most popular options:

For smaller groups, the Boat Rental Marbella fleet also includes the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax). All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

What’s Included in Every Charter

When you book a Sotogrande boat rental no license, you get a complete package:

  • Licensed skipper (handles everything)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

No hidden extras. Just turn up at Puerto Banús and step aboard.

Route from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande

Departing from Puerto Banús, you’ll cruise south-west along the coast. The journey to Sotogrande takes about 20–30 minutes at 20–25 knots. Along the way, you’ll pass Marbella’s Golden Mile, the dunes of Cabopino, and the scenic cliffs near Estepona. Once in Sotogrande, you can anchor near the marina or explore the nearby beaches like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Many charters include a stop for swimming and lunch at a beachfront chiringuito.

How to Book Your No-License Boat

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We’ll confirm availability and send a quote. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is fixed at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, pricing starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski. All other boats are quoted on request.

Tips for a Great Sotogrande Boat Trip

  • Book in advance, especially during July and August.
  • Bring sunscreen, a towel, and a hat—the sun is strong.
  • Arrive 15 minutes early at Puerto Banús for boarding.
  • If you want to dine at a Sotogrande restaurant, ask us to arrange a table.
  • Consider a full-day charter (8h) to explore both Sotogrande and Estepona.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a license to rent a boat in Sotogrande?

No. All our charters include a professional licensed skipper who handles navigation. You simply relax and enjoy the coast.

Where do the boats depart from?

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, about 20–30 minutes by car from Sotogrande. We can arrange a taxi or transfer if needed.

What boats are available for a Sotogrande trip?

We offer a range: the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h), Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, €749/2h), and the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, €4,719/4h). Other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Canados 86 are available on request.

What is included in the price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). No hidden costs.

How long does it take to reach Sotogrande by boat?

From Puerto Banús, it takes about 20–30 minutes cruising at 20–25 knots, depending on the boat. The route passes Marbella’s coastline and Estepona.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring additional food and drinks. The basic bar is included, but we can also arrange catering for an extra fee.

What is the cancellation policy?

We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. Within 48 hours, a 50% charge applies. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable.

How do I book a boat for Sotogrande?

Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. We’ll confirm the boat, time, and any extras. A deposit secures your booking.
